question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Delicious
solution:
The correct answer is "**Distasteful**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Delicious** means something that **tastes very good.**

 
 
• **Example:** *My mother cooks **deliciously. ***
 
 
 
• **Distasteful** means something that **tastes very bad.**
 
 
• **Example:** *I felt that the food from the newly opened restaurant was **distasteful.*** 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of Delicious is Distasteful. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satisfactory** - upholds the required level.

 
 
• **Example:** *Jerry's team managing skills were just **satisfactory.** *
 
 
 
• **Sweet** - containing a lot of sugar.
 
 
• **Example:** *My grandfather was not allowed to eat **sweets** because of his diabetes. *
 
 
 
• **Tasteful** - something that is very pleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** *Rita's designing ideas look **tasteful. ** *
